stage: L6 reliable surface nodes and revocable shared fixed-stiffness springs
held: global odd indices; no auxiliary loss, ordinary RGB remains trained
association: All730 saved bidirectional RGB tracks. Adjacent windows stitch by mutual nearest fit-only overlap RMS<=.75, max<=1.5, alternative margin>=.25 if rival exists. Union cannot contain two tracks from same window or any inconsistent fit overlap. Held only validates chosen graph, never nominates/replaces links. All original tracks/rejected links/unknown memories retained.
canonical_binding: Only a T4-qualified root row may nominate canonical association. Fit selects among nominated rows; original2px split RMS/4px maximum plus separated-rival .25px margin and swapped-split same/equivalent .01world/.75px validate. Parent positions are hypothesis for binding, never geometryGT or target depth. Current full-scene native one-hot visibility and raw RGB NCC validate every memory observation. Memory requires>=16 observed frames across>=2 windows; no gap interpolation or reappearance identity claim without overlapping evidence.
visibility: At least ceil(2/3 each split) and4 per split, >=8 total passing; geometry/texture/visibility missing is unknown and retained. Unobserved frames get no loss. Two contradictions revoke/two passes recover; loss immediately guards positive depth and <=4px.
objective: Both arms full-image0.8L1+.2DSSIM plus identical L4 temporal memory and250-step memory refresh. Candidate alone adds fixed-k spring strain using original admitted L5 patches, own-node/edge qualification and instantaneous projection guards. No damping/thickness/area/contribution-loss or physics update.
qualification: Before formal training: unit/held-leakage/stitch-conflict/missing/gradient/default-off tests, full native evidence independent replay, flags-off exact RGB/alpha/D and original gradient tolerance; finite intended canonical/grid/deform gradients;20-step smoke per arm and four independent exact model/twoAdam/bindings/RNG/camera/physics/memory recovery processes plus same-native-gradient exact Adam; retain original40step nondeterminism failures.
coverage: One local temporal-fusion prototype. Require at least one genuinely cross-window >=16-observation native-admitted memory before any training; original T3/T4/L3 global coverage failures remain and all thirds/counts/spans reported. If zero, stop without relaxing checks, no fallback candidate.
evaluation: All30 native1600 validation, both original max0.3dB PSNR regression gates plus actual86/188 early/middle/late completeness/tail cleanup. Fixed initial360 patch-frame diagnostics, spring strain/stretch/compression counts and all denominator/unknowns. Full state/PLY/two200-frame decoded videos. No promotion from RGB or rest-length fit alone.
recovery: Human-approved exact full model/twoAdam/RNG/camera/physics/memory controller restoration plus same-native-gradient exact Adam; native gradient atol1e-6 rtol1e-5, original eps1e-15
limitations: Early-biased local coverage inherited. Fixed parent median rest may suppress legitimate deformation or preserve fragments; k dimensionless regularization, no mass or physical elasticity identification. Historical color lineage disclosed. No independent dynamic3D/thicknessGT.
structure: Original initially admitted L5 patch membership/edge bank is recomputed read-only and compared exactly. Fixed median fit-length spring reference, four-point patch admission, all unknown/rejected hypotheses preserved. Unknown pauses, two contradictions revoke, two passes restore.
thickness: Not constrained in L6; original L5 support proxies are evaluation only, not physical body/wall thickness.
completeness: No surface growth, closure, masks or alpha-one. Existing L5 diagnostics and fixed views assess possible deterioration; no completeness guarantee.
matching: Same exact complete J6 model/twoAdam/bindings/RNG/camera/physics; both arms refresh memory, candidate also original L3 qualification. Each2000 updates; one candidate, no automatic extension or sweep.
spring_reference: Per initially admitted patch edge, median of its six original even-fit J6 lengths; fixed across time; parent-derived, not measured rest geometry.
spring_energy: sqrt(1+((length-rest)/rest)^2)-1, shared k=1; confidence detached; fixed initial applicable patch denominator, edge mean within patch; outer weight0.01.
